key_points: ORCL faces high debt and execution risks highlighted by a 14‑month low share price.
Clarified OpenAI revenue and AI data‑center delays are pressuring the stock.
Positive AI developments: Gemini joins Oracle’s AI lineup and agentic AI rollout underway.
Mixed institutional activity: some buying (Valley Wealth) but also selling (Douglas Lane) and position exits.
Analyst consensus price target around $252 and a top investor view that fundamentals are not bleak provide limited upside.
